title: Short Stirling EH977
memorial_details:
Rough hewn stone monolith with aluminium plaque attached bearing RAF Bomber Command insignia. See also IWM 104146

Commissioned and erected by the Lincolnshire Aircraft Recovery Group for the 70th Anniversary on behalf of the families.
inscription: Plaque: (Bomber Command badge)/ In this area lie the remains of Short Stirling EH977/ Coded -Z of 1660 Heavy Conversion Unit./ Based at RAF Swinderby./ EH977 crashed on 5th November 1944 after an engine failure./ Killing all of the crew./ In Memory of/ (Names)/ Commissioned and erected by the Lincolnshire Aircraft Recovery Group for the 70th Anniversary/ on behalf of the families./
